watches.name: HENNING XO
watches.description: Halda Henning XO measures 40 mm in diameter and is made entirely in 18K solid gold with the tone of Swedish red gold, just like the old pocket watches. This timepiece will be produced in a limited edition of only 10 pieces and comes with an oak bark tanned leather bracelet from Böle Garveri – Handmade in Sweden. The movement was made in Sweden more than 100 years ago at the end of the 19th century. It has been further developed by today’s watchmakers at Halda Watch Co. A new bridge has been designed and decorated and new gearwheels have been made from scratch. All this in order to move the small second hand so that the winding stem and crown is on the right side like a traditional wristwatch. PLEASE NOTE: This timepiece is made to order upon your request, delivery time may vary. Contact info@haldasweden.com for more information.

watches.name: RACE PILOT | OCTANE BLACK
watches.description: Limited edition of 25 pieces. Octane Black features a self-winding movement from ZENITH with date, sub-second and power reserve indicator. The 45mm case is processed out of titanium and finished with a black DLC coating. It is built to withstand a pressure equivalent to 10 ATM (100 meters). The Octane Black dial is made from 20 individually manufactured pieces carefully applied on a base of carbon fiber. For visual functionality, indexes and the tips of the hands are highlighted with Superluminova. The watch is delivered in a handmade wooden box, featuring the unique and award-winning Halda time platform in black DLC and a strap in natural rubber.

watches.name: SPACE DISCOVERY | MECHANICAL
watches.description: The Space Discovery Mechanical features a self-winding high-beat movement from A. Schild operating at the frequency of 36.000bph (5Hz). Diameter of the watch is 45mm and the case and bezel are processed out of stainless steel. It houses a matte black dial with luminous hands and applied indexes as well as a quick-set date function with controlled by pushing the crown. The watch is delivered in a handmade wooden box, featuring the unique and award-winning Halda time platform and bracelet in natural rubber. This Halda timepiece is built to withstand a pressure equivalent to 10 ATM (100 meters).
